summary: Projects feature — full backend (16/16 pytest pass) + frontend (Playwright) end-to-end testing. All admin flows (sidebar nav, create dialog, link existing, project banner on gig detail, unlink/relink via PickProjectForGigDialog, archive lifecycle) and worker flows (worker-project-card with siblings + crew on a project-linked gig, absent on unlinked gig) work correctly. One minor UI display issue spotted on the archived projects list (newly-archived empty project's title row renders blank). Note delete button selector not confirmed during playwright run.

ui_bugs.issue: After archiving a freshly-created project with no linked gigs, the resulting card in the Archived tab renders with the section label 'PROJECT' but the project title row is blank. The two previously-archived projects on the same page (TEST_iterproj_worker_13c8c and TEST_iterproj_caaa9e_upd) render their titles correctly, so the bug is conditional. Possible causes: a) ProjectCard uses a fallback that hides title when client_name is also empty, b) the just-saved project's title isn't picked up until full reload. Reproduce: click 'New project' → fill only title+client → submit → archive → switch to Archived tab. data-testid proj-card-{project_id} also was not found for the new card while it is found for the older ones.

action_items: Investigate the archived-projects card render: confirm `proj-card-{project_id}` testid is rendered for archived projects on the same list page (was missing for a fresh archive in this run). Likely candidate: AdminProjects page filters or maps archived projects through a different code path than active ones, or the just-archived project isn't being refetched after redirect. Repro: create project via UI → immediately click Archive → switch to Archived tab.

(Optional) Document where the note-row delete button lives on AdminProjectDetail — the note was created (data-testid proj-note-note_xxx rendered) but no element with delete-button data-testid was found inside the note container. If delete is implemented add a data-testid like `proj-note-delete-{note_id}` to make automated cleanup testable. Backend DELETE /api/projects/{id}/notes/{note_id} works (verified).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 5253 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline. Projects code (3170-3375) is well-contained but the file as a whole is overdue for splitting into routers/ subpackages (gigs, projects, admin, public, workers, ratings).

DELETE /api/projects/{project_id} (server.py:3300) is named 'archive' but uses HTTP DELETE semantics — fine for REST conventions, but the route bypasses any not-found check on the unlinking step (`update_many` with `project_id` is idempotent). 404 is correctly raised if project doesn't exist.

POST /api/gigs/{gig_id}/link-to-project: sync_defaults overwrites gig fields when keys are present in project.defaults. There's no `unset/clear` flag — once defaults are applied they aren't reversible without an explicit edit. Document this in the dialog ('Will overwrite location/scheduled_at/etc.').

GET /api/gigs (admin) now does an extra db.projects.find for every list call. With 151 unlinked gigs in DB and few project pids, the pid set query (line 1056) is fine; if pids grows to 1000+, consider caching the project map for a few seconds.
GET /api/gigs/{gig_id} (worker enrichment, lines 1136-1200) correctly strips PII from sibling crew (only first_name + gig_role surface). Verified in tests.
